scope: Data and CPU combat verification of forty new independent ATB enemy samples; not source-mission encounters.

assertions: Exact forty unique factual contextual enemy identities, all absent from the existing sixteen.
Existing source IDs and record descriptions/conditions preserved; no catalogue modification.
Deeply frozen, bounded data; no reward, recruitment or narrative result fields.
Four DLC records closed independently of broad campaign-period availability.
Canonical occurrence checked across every published work/period; no prologue or multiplayer opening.
No named powers, camouflage, boss phases or encounter outcome inferred from role labels.
Every open sample acts and damages an abstract target through the native combat engine.
Every open sample can be defeated using only real shoot orders from three abstract test actors.

partyVictory.stateMutation: Native tickBattle and performAction only; no direct hp, atb or winner assignments.

protocol.closedProfiles: The four blocked DLC samples are inspected as immutable data only; no combat execution is claimed for them.

limitations: These are forty new identity profiles, not forty canonical encounters or completed source missions.
Stats, shields, cadence and basic shoot/strike actions are ATB adaptation values.
Published secondary catalogue evidence identifies enemies; no new primary kit, numeric or model validation was performed.
DLC entitlement is not represented by the independent main-period context. Vasir, the yahg Broker, Rampart and Adjutant remain closed.
The piloted Atlas is not treated as an autonomous synthetic target, avoiding an unsupported automatic hacking classification.
Camouflage, flight, physical shields, unit support, giant scale and boss phases remain explicitly incomplete where applicable.
No campaign, chronicle story, source catalogue, existing opponent, UI, save format or combat source was modified by this task.
No rendered art, animation, audio, browser integration or artistic 1:1 fidelity was verified.
